name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Autocomplete input and command palette with a list of suggestions, filtered as the user types.

props.name: allowCustomValue
props.description: Whether to allow typing custom values in the input

props.name: alwaysSubmitOnEnter
props.description:
Whether to always submit on Enter key press, even if popup is open.
Useful for single-field autocomplete forms where Enter should submit the form.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether to autofocus the input on mount

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether to close the combobox when an item is selected.

props.name: composite
props.description: Whether the combobox is a composed with other composite widgets like tabs

props.name: defaultHighlightedValue
props.description:
The initial highlighted value of the combobox when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the highlighted value of the combobox.

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description:
The initial value of the combobox's input when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the combobox's input.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the combobox when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the combobox.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the combobox's selected items when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the combobox's selected items.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the combobox is disabled

props.name: disableLayer
props.description: Whether to disable registering this a dismissable layer

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the combobox.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: highlightedValue
props.description: The controlled highlighted value of the combobox

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the combobox. Useful for composition.

props.name: inputBehavior
props.description:
Defines the auto-completion behavior of the combobox.

- `autohighlight`: The first focused item is highlighted as the user types
- `autocomplete`: Navigating the listbox with the arrow keys selects the item and the input is updated

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The controlled value of the combobox's input

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the combobox is invalid

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop the keyboard navigation through the items

props.name: multiple
props.description:
Whether to allow multiple selection.

**Good to know:** When `multiple` is `true`, the `selectionBehavior` is automatically set to `clear`.
It is recommended to render the selected items in a separate container.

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` attribute of the combobox's input. Useful for form submission

props.name: navigate
props.description: Function to navigate to the selected item

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the combobox

props.name: openOnChange
props.description: Whether to show the combobox when the input value changes

props.name: openOnClick
props.description: Whether to open the combobox popup on initial click on the input

props.name: openOnKeyPress
props.description: Whether to open the combobox on arrow key press

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder text of the combobox's input

props.name: positioning
props.description: The positioning options to dynamically position the menu

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the combobox is readonly. This puts the combobox in a "non-editable" mode
but the user can still interact with it

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the combobox is required

props.name: scrollToIndexFn
props.description: Function to scroll to a specific index

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description:
The behavior of the combobox input when an item is selected

- `replace`: The selected item string is set as the input value
- `clear`: The input value is cleared
- `preserve`: The input value is preserved

props.name: showClear
props.description: Show the clear ("x") button when a value is selected.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the combobox's selected items

events.name: onFocusOutside
events.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

events.name: onHighlightChange
events.description:
Function called when an item is highlighted using the pointer
or keyboard navigation.

events.name: onInputValueChange
events.description: Function called when the input's value changes

events.name: onInteractOutside
events.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Function called when the popup is opened

events.name: onPointerDownOutside
events.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

events.name: onSelect
events.description: Function called when an item is selected

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Function called when a new item is selected

keyboard.description: Move the highlighted item down or up the (open) list.
Close the list without changing the selection.
Jump the highlight to the first or last item.

accessibilityNotes: Built on `@zag-js/combobox`, which implements the [ARIA combobox pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/) (`role="combobox"` on the input, `role="listbox"` on the list, `aria-activedescendant` tracking the highlighted item).
`invalid` sets `aria-invalid` on the input and `data-invalid` throughout the part tree, so both assistive tech and the `has-aria-invalid:` styling hooks pick it up from one prop.
In `multiple` mode, each selected chip carries its own focusable remove button (`data-slot="combobox-chip-remove"`) rather than only being removable by re-selecting in the list.
`dir="rtl"` is a real machine prop, not just a CSS toggle — it also reverses Zag's arrow-key navigation and floating-list positioning to match reading direction.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source:
import Combobox from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/combobox/combobox.marko";
import Field from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field.marko";
import FieldLabel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-label.marko";

static const categories = [
  { value: "technology", label: "التكنولوجيا" },
  { value: "design", label: "التصميم" },
  { value: "business", label: "الأعمال" },
  { value: "marketing", label: "التسويق" },
  { value: "education", label: "التعليم" },
  { value: "health", label: "الصحة" },
];

<Field dir="rtl" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-xs">
  <FieldLabel for="combobox-rtl-input">الفئات</FieldLabel>
  <Combobox
    items=categories
    multiple
    inputBehavior="autohighlight"
    defaultValue=["technology"]
    placeholder="أضف فئات"
    ids={ input: "combobox-rtl-input" }
    dir="rtl"
  />
</Field>
examples.description: `dir` is a real `@zag-js/combobox` prop — it drives both the DOM attribute and Zag's RTL-aware keyboard/positioning logic.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Combobox from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/combobox/combobox.marko"; static const frameworks = [ { value: "next", label: "Next.js" }, { value: "sveltekit", label: "SvelteKit" }, { value: "nuxt", label: "Nuxt.js" }, { value: "remix", label: "Remix" }, { value: "astro", label: "Astro" }, { value: "marko", label: "Marko" }, ];
{ value = next; } /> value: ${value.join(", ") || "(none)"}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`.

composition:
Our `<Combobox>` is a single tag, not a compound-component tree — everything
upstream expresses as nested parts (`ComboboxInput`, `ComboboxContent`,
`ComboboxItem`, `ComboboxChips`...) is a prop or a rendered slot here,
driven by one `@zag-js/combobox` machine.

**Simple** (see [Default](#combobox-demo)): pass `items`. The tag renders its
own input, trigger button, and a floating list — no assembly required.

```text
Combobox (items=)
├── input           (data-slot="combobox-input")
├── trigger button  (data-slot="combobox-trigger")
└── positioner      (data-slot="combobox-positioner", portalled)
    └── list        (data-slot="combobox-list")
        └── item    (data-slot="combobox-item", one per entry)
```

**With chips** (see [Multiple Selection](#combobox-multiple)): pass
`multiple`. The single input is swapped for a chip row with an inline text
input — selected items render as `data-slot="combobox-chip"` pills, each
with its own remove button.

```text
Combobox (items= multiple)
├── chips            (data-slot="combobox-chips")
│   ├── chip         (data-slot="combobox-chip", one per selected value)
│   └── chip input   (data-slot="combobox-chip-input")
└── positioner → list → item  (same as Simple)
```

**With groups** (see [Groups](#combobox-groups)): pass `groups` alongside
the flat `items` (items still drives the filterable collection; groups is a
display-only regrouping of the same values). Each group renders a label and
its own item block, separated visually.

```text
Combobox (items= groups=)
└── positioner → list
    ├── group        (data-slot="combobox-group")
    │   ├── label    (data-slot="combobox-label")
    │   └── collection (data-slot="combobox-collection")
    │       └── item (one per group entry)
    ├── separator    (data-slot="combobox-separator", between groups)
    └── group ...
```
